items.title: ACE-Compression: An Ability-Centric Evaluation of Compressed Large Language Models
items.title_zh: ACE-Compression：压缩大型语言模型的以能力为中心的评估
items.summary_zh: 模型压缩使大型语言模型可部署，但当今的评估讲述了一个不完整的故事。标准实践衡量保留的任务性能并止步于此。这忽略了一个关键事实：压缩扰动了嵌入数十亿权重中的分布式知识，仅任务分数无法揭示哪些底层能力幸存、哪些悄然崩溃。为解决这个问题，我们引入ACE-Compression，一个以能力为中心的评估框架。我们不仅问“压缩模型是否仍能正确回答？”，而是问“其核心能力中哪些保持完整？”我们的框架探测四个面向部署的维度：程序推理与约束执行、知识基础与真实性、社会认知与情感理解、人格保真度与风格一致性。在来自六个开放权重LLM的超过35个压缩检查点中——涵盖量化和剪枝——我们发现压缩重新分配了能力概况。粗略、局部和表面信号通常持续，而细粒度、长尾和上下文依赖的能力变得脆弱。量化在保留方面始终优于剪枝，但这种差距的实际意义完全取决于应用需要哪种能力。基于我们的发现，部署者可以根据其应用所需的能力概况选择压

extra.description: Model compression makes large language models deployable, but today's evaluation tells an incomplete story. Standard practice measures retained task performance and stops there. This misses a critical fact: compression perturbs the distributed knowledge embedded across billions of weights, and task scores alone cannot reveal which underlying abilities survive and which quietly collapse. To solve this question, we introduce ACE-Compression, an ability-centric evaluation framework. Instead of asking only "does the compressed model still answer correctly?", we ask "which of its core abilities remain intact?" Our framework probes four deployment-facing dimensions: procedural reasoning and constraint execution, knowledge grounding and truthfulness, social cognition and affective understanding, and persona fidelity and stylistic consistency. Across more than 35 compressed checkpoints from six open-weight LLMs-covering quantization and pruning-we find that compression redistributes ability profiles. Coarse, local, and surface-level signals often persist, while fine-grained, long-tail, and context-dependent abilities become fragile. Quantization consistently outperforms pruning in retention, but the practical meaning of that gap depends entirely on which ability an application requires. Based on our findings, deployers can choose compression methods by the ability profile their application needs, not just by a leaderboard average. And algorithm designers gain diagnostic signals to build compression methods that preserve what matters. We believe that ACE-Compression turns compression from a black-box accuracy drop into an interpretable intervention-one we can measure, understand, and ultimately improve.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Mapping the spatial architecture of glioblastoma from core to edge delineates niche-specific tumor cell states and intercellular interactions
items.title_zh: 从核心到边缘绘制胶质母细胞瘤的空间结构， delineates 生态位特异性肿瘤细胞状态和细胞间相互作用
items.summary_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）的治疗耐药性主要由该疾病典型的广泛多层次异质性驱动。尽管在阐明GBM的基因组和转录异质性方面取得了重大进展，但在空间层面定义这种异质性仍存在关键知识空白。为解决此问题，我们采用空间转录组学绘制GBM生态系统的结构。这揭示了由基因表达和空间定位共同定义的肿瘤细胞状态，以及沿肿瘤核心-边缘轴组成变化的多细胞生态位。配体-受体相互作用分析揭示了复杂的细胞间通讯网络，包括生态位和区域特异性相互作用。最后，我们发现CD8+GZMK+ T细胞与LYVE1+ CD163+髓系细胞在血管区域共定位，提示免疫逃逸的潜在机制。这些发现为GBM肿瘤微环境提供了新见解，突出了以前未认识到的空间组织和细胞间相互作用模式，以及破坏促肿瘤相互作用和克服免疫耐药的新治疗途径。

extra.description: Treatment resistance in glioblastoma (GBM) is largely driven by the extensive multi-level heterogeneity that typifies this disease. Despite significant progress toward elucidating GBM's genomic and transcriptional heterogeneity, a critical knowledge gap remains in defining this heterogeneity at the spatial level. To address this, we employed spatial transcriptomics to map the architecture of the GBM ecosystem. This revealed tumor cell states that are jointly defined by gene expression and spatial localization, and multicellular niches whose composition varies along the tumor core-edge axis. Ligand-receptor interaction analysis uncovered a complex network of intercellular communication, including niche- and region-specific interactions. Finally, we found that CD8+GZMK+ T cells colocalize with LYVE1+ CD163+ myeloid cells in vascular regions, suggesting a potential mechanism for immune evasion. These findings provide novel insights into the GBM tumor microenvironment, highlighting previously unrecognized patterns of spatial organization and intercellular interactions, and novel therapeutic avenues to disrupt tumor-promoting interactions and overcome immune resistance.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: APRIL: Ambiguity-Aware Expert Routing for Respiratory Sound Domain-Incremental Learning
items.title_zh: APRIL：用于呼吸音域增量学习的歧义感知专家路由
items.summary_zh: 自动呼吸音分类可实现连续、非侵入性呼吸评估，但由于记录设备和采集时期的演变导致的域偏移，长期部署仍具挑战性。当隐私和治理法规禁止重放历史数据时，顺序学习容易覆盖先前获得的知识。保留专用域专家可防止参数干扰，但在重叠声学分布和缺乏域标签的情况下，推理时选择正确专家很困难。为解决这一困境，我们提出APRIL，一个用于RSC的无样本域增量框架。基于共享冻结的BEATs骨干，APRIL顺序继承和隔离低秩专家，以实现新域适应而不改变早期模型。多级原型路由器检索前两名候选专家，并通过将域路由后验与分类置信度整合，由匹配歧义自适应加权，动态选择最终模型。我们在ICBHI和SPRSound数据集上建立了标准化的设备和时间增量基准，涵盖正向和反向域顺序。在五个随机种子上评估，APRIL在比较的持续学习方法中始终获得最高的最终会话平均分数，在ICBHI上达到64.4%和65.4%，在SPRSound上正向和反

extra.description: Automated respiratory sound classification enables continuous, non-invasive respiratory assessment, yet long-term deployment remains challenging due to domain shifts from evolving recording devices and acquisition periods. When privacy and governance regulations prohibit replaying historical data, sequential learning easily overwrites previously acquired knowledge. Preserving dedicated domain experts prevents parameter interference, but selecting the correct expert at inference is difficult under overlapping acoustic distributions and absent domain labels. To resolve this dilemma, we propose APRIL, an exemplar-free domain-incremental framework for RSC. Built on a shared frozen BEATs backbone, APRIL sequentially inherits and isolates low-rank experts to enable new-domain adaptation without altering earlier models. A multi-level prototype router retrieves the top-two candidate experts and dynamically selects the final model by integrating domain-routing posteriors with classification confidence, adaptively weighted by matching ambiguity. We establish standardized device- and temporal-incremental benchmarks on the ICBHI and SPRSound datasets across forward and reversed domain orders. Evaluated over five random seeds, APRIL consistently achieves the highest final-session average Score among compared continual learning approaches, reaching 64.4% and 65.4% on ICBHI, and 83.1% and 82.2% on SPRSound under forward and reversed sequences, respectively. Crucially, average forgetting remains under 1.0% across all protocols, demonstrating robust domain adaptation and long-term knowledge retention without data replay. Overall, APRIL offers a reliable and privacy-preserving paradigm for deploying continuous respiratory sound classification across real-world healthcare settings.

items.title: HypTI: Hyperbolic Geometry-Aware Multimodal Feature Fusion Framework for Dementia Detection Based on Tabular-Image Data
items.title_zh: HypTI：基于表格-图像数据的双曲几何感知多模态特征融合框架用于痴呆检测
items.summary_zh: AI辅助痴呆检测通常需要融合多种数据，如临床表格评估和神经影像数据。然而，大多数现有方法在欧几里得空间进行特征融合。这忽略了表示的几何结构，包括临床评估中的层次组织和神经影像数据中的多尺度解剖模式。近期研究证明双曲空间由于其指数扩展空间，为建模层次和多尺度结构提供了自然几何。受此启发，我们提出HypTI，一个基于临床表格评估和MRI扫描的双曲几何感知多模态融合框架用于痴呆检测。HypTI将双曲表示学习扩展到未充分探索的表格-MRI设置，在双曲空间中联合建模临床表格、MRI扫描和跨模态交互。具体而言，临床表格变量通过可学习Lorentz原型表示以捕获评估间的层次关系，而MRI扫描使用ROI引导的多尺度表示学习编码以捕获Lorentz空间中跨脑区和空间尺度的解剖模式。多模态表示通过自适应融合模块整合，生成受试者特定的尺度和偏移系数以动态调制和整合多模态嵌入，实现有效的患者级表格-图像表示学习用

extra.description: AI-assisted dementia detection usually requires multimodal fusion of diverse data, such as clinical tabular assessments and neuroimaging data. However, most existing approaches perform feature fusion in Euclidean space. This overlooks the geometric structure of representation, including hierarchical organization in clinical assessments and multi-scale anatomical patterns in neuroimaging data. Recent studies have proved hyperbolic space provides a natural geometry for modelling hierarchical and multi-scale structures due to its exponentially expanding space. Motivated by these, we propose HypTI, a hyperbolic geometry-aware multimodal fusion framework for dementia detection based on clinical tabular assessments and MRI scans. HypTI extends hyperbolic representation learning to an underexplored tabular-MRI setting, jointly modelling clinical tabular, MRI scans, and cross-modal interactions in hyperbolic space. Specifically, clinical tabular variables are represented through learnable Lorentz prototypes to capture hierarchical relationships among assessments, while MRI scans are encoded using ROI-guided multi-scale representation learning to capture anatomical patterns across brain regions and spatial scales in Lorentz space. The multimodal representations are integrated through an adaptive fusion module generates subject-specific scale and shift coefficients to dynamically modulate and integrate the multimodal embeddings, enabling effective patient-level tabular-image representation learning for dementia detection. Experiments on OASIS-3 dataset show that the proposed framework achieves strong performance compared with representative approaches.

items.title: From Comparison to Selection: Enhancing Cross-Scale Generalization of Pointer Networks Trained with Reinforcement Learning for Capacitated Drone Delivery Routing
items.title_zh: 从比较到选择：增强用于容量约束无人机配送路径规划的强化学习指针网络的跨尺度泛化
items.summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）可实现快速、灵活的最后一英里和紧急配送，但其路径规划因客户数量变化而仍具挑战性。基于混合整数规划和启发式的经典方法可能扩展性差或需要问题特定设计，促使基于学习的替代方案。强化学习特别有前景，前提是单一策略能在无需重新训练的情况下跨问题规模泛化。尽管基于注意力的指针网络本质上是规模无关的，但其解质量在放大和缩小下均下降。使用容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）作为受控代理，固定容量反映无人机有效载荷约束，我们研究这种退化并识别三个 contributing 因素：节点密度偏移、注意力分散和均值池化图上下文稀释。我们系统比较架构级、编码器侧和解码器侧修改以解决这些限制，并提出一种学习的、排列不变图上下文聚合机制，实现为加权平均和Set2Set。结果揭示了每个方向迁移的不同需求：基于熵的注意力缩放将CVRP20到CVRP100的性能差距减少1.41个百分点，而所提出的聚合方法在更具挑

extra.description: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) enable fast, flexible last-mile and emergency delivery, but their routing remains challenging as the number of clients varies. Classical approaches based on mixed-integer programming and heuristics can scale poorly or require problem-specific design, motivating learning-based alternatives. Reinforcement learning is particularly promising, provided a single policy can generalize across problem sizes without retraining. Although attention-based Pointer Networks are inherently size-agnostic, their solution quality degrades under both upscaling and downscaling. Using the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) as a controlled proxy, with fixed capacity reflecting drone payload constraints, we investigate this degradation and identify three contributing factors: shifts in node density, attention dispersion, and dilution of the mean-pooled graph context. We systematically compare architecture-wide, encoder-side, and decoder-side modifications to address these limitations and propose a learned, permutation-invariant graph-context aggregation mechanism, implemented as a weighted average and as Set2Set. Results reveal distinct requirements for transfer in each direction: entropy-based attention scaling reduces the CVRP20-to-CVRP100 performance gap by 1.41 percentage points, while the proposed aggregation methods achieve the largest improvement on the more challenging CVRP100-to-CVRP20 transfer, approximately 0.9 percentage points. Exploiting this complementarity, we introduce an approach selector that chooses the best model for each training-target size pair. The selector reduces cost relative to the reference model across all nine seen train-test pairs and eight of nine pairs involving unseen sizes (CVRP35, CVRP75, and CVRP200), achieving improvements of up to 3.2 percent.

items.title: Quantum-JEPA: Quantum Born Priors for Latent-Action JEPA World Models
items.title_zh: Quantum-JEPA：用于潜在动作JEPA世界模型的量子Born先验
items.summary_zh: 单一观察可以承认多个合理未来，使不确定性成为世界建模的重要部分。然而，量子生成模型在此任务中仍未充分探索。我们引入Quantum-JEPA，一个潜在动作JEPA框架，使用条件量子Born先验学习未来表示分布。电路测量生成二元潜在动作，共享预测器将其映射到替代未来表示。我们通过采样的能量目标，使用这些预测的质量和多样性训练量子先验。我们的模型在构建的多模态任务上学习不同的延续，并捕获支持协调多智能体未来的潜在动作相关性。在D3IL（多样人类演示基准）上，我们训练的模型从共同起点生成多条避障路线而无需观察运动。在受控任务上，我们的经典和量子先验实现相比评估的变分基线提高了预测有效性和分布保真度。我们的量子先验将竞争性预测质量与参数高效采样结构相结合：它们避免指数大小的分类输出层，同时支持相关潜在动作。我们进一步验证有限次参数偏移训练，包括带读出噪声的训练。与大多数专注于模拟的先前工作不同，我们

extra.description: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.

items.title: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
items.title_zh: MMEnterprise-Bench：评估企业代理在不断演变的多模态记录上的表现
items.summary_zh: 企业代理回答关于通过团队协作演变的工作场所记录的问题。随着信息在文档、聊天和图表中被共享、更正和修订，同一信息的多个版本在工作区中积累。因此，可靠的问答要求代理在足够证据上推理、解决跨源和时间冲突，并识别可用证据不足以确定答案的情况。为系统评估这些能力，我们引入MMEnterprise-Bench，一个包含1,613个问题的基准，基于模拟协作项目中不断演变的多模态记录，涵盖三个类别：证据推理、冲突解决和不可回答性。我们评估了10个专有和开源多模态LLM，发现即使最强模型在证据包含跨源或时间冲突或跨越多个图像时也表现不佳。此外，增加检索预算或使用更大检索器提高证据召回率，但并不一致地转化为更高的答案准确性。这些发现突出了在不断演变的工作场所记录上推理的持续挑战，并将MMEnterprise-Bench确立为开发更可靠企业代理的测试平台。代码和数据可在https://mlvlab.github

extra.description: Enterprise agents answer questions over workplace records that evolve through team collaboration. As information is shared, corrected, and revised across documents, chats, and figures, multiple versions of the same information accumulate in the workspace. Reliable question answering therefore requires agents to reason over sufficient evidence, resolve cross-source and temporal conflicts, and recognize when the available evidence is insufficient to establish an answer. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce MMEnterprise-Bench, a benchmark comprising 1,613 questions grounded in evolving multimodal records from simulated collaboration projects, covering three categories: Evidence Reasoning, Conflict Resolution, and Unanswerability. We evaluate 10 proprietary and open-source multimodal LLMs and find that even the strongest models struggle when evidence contains cross-source or temporal conflicts or spans multiple images. Moreover, increasing the retrieval budget or employing a larger retriever improves evidence recall but does not consistently translate into higher answer accuracy. These findings highlight the persistent challenges of reasoning over evolving workplace records and establish MMEnterprise-Bench as a testbed for developing more reliable enterprise agents. Code and data are available at https://mlvlab.github.io/MMEnterprise-Bench/.

items.title: Polarity Blindness in LLM Safety: A Systematic Study of Negation, Antonym Substitution, and Adversarial Framing
items.title_zh: LLM安全中的极性盲区：否定、反义词替换和对抗性框架的系统研究
items.summary_zh: 否定仍是语言模型在各类NLP任务和模态中持续存在的挑战。我们表明，这一弱点可通过我们称为极性盲的结构性漏洞削弱LLM安全护栏：即在改变极性的语言转换后无法识别有害意图。我们研究两种极性反转形式：语法否定和反义词替换，并以同义词替换作为保持极性的对照。我们进一步测试对抗性文本包装是否放大这些失败。使用涵盖10个最先进LLM和3种语言（英语、西班牙语、捷克语）的260条提示基准，按潜在危害性分层并在经验证的0-5危害量表上评估，我们发现极性盲影响大多数受评估模型，最脆弱模型的平均危害得分达到4.12。该效应在类型学不同的否定系统中持续存在，表明极性盲反映的是语义鲁棒性的更广泛局限，而非语言或语法特定的失败。

extra.description: Negation remains a persistent challenge for language models across NLP tasks and modalities. We show that this weakness can undermine LLM safety guardrails through a structural vulnerability we term polarity blindness: the failure to recognize harmful intent after polarity-altering linguistic transformations. We study two forms of polarity inversion: grammatical negation and antonym replacement, and use synonym replacement as a polarity-preserving control. We further test whether an adversarial textual wrapper amplifies these failures. Using a 260-prompt benchmark across 10 state-of-the-art LLMs and 3 languages (English, Spanish, Czech), stratified by harmfulness potential and evaluated on a validated 0-5 harm scale, we find that polarity blindness affects most evaluated models, with mean harm scores reaching 4.12 for the most vulnerable model. The effect persists across typologically differing negation systems, suggesting that polarity blindness reflects a broader limitation in semantic robustness rather than a language- or grammar-specific failure.

items.title: Staged Continual Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models for Japanese Financial Documents
items.title_zh: 面向日本金融文档的多模态基础模型分阶段持续适应
items.summary_zh: 多模态基础模型的分阶段后训练将视觉-语言对齐、推理蒸馏和领域调优串联起来，但每个阶段如何以其他能力为代价进行权衡仍缺乏充分刻画。追踪一个8.4B参数模型从未经微调的基线经过日本金融文档上的三个训练阶段（在五个文本输入基准上评估），我们发现各阶段以非加性方式交互：仅数学蒸馏会覆盖先前获得的金融知识，尽管程序性数学技能得以保留，而领域阶段修复多于安装。跳过阶段的消融对领域知识最佳但放弃数值推理增益，因此各阶段贡献不可分解，最佳检查点取决于任务，这对检查点保留和调度而非增加阶段具有启示。

extra.description: Staged post-training of multimodal foundation models chains vision-language alignment, reasoning distillation, and domain tuning, yet how each phase trades capabilities against the others remains under-characterised. Tracking an 8.4B-parameter model from an un-fine-tuned baseline through three training phases on Japanese financial documents (evaluated on five text-input benchmarks), we find the phases interact non-additively: math-only distillation overwrites the financial knowledge acquired earlier even as procedural math skill survives, and the domain phase repairs more than it installs. A skip-phase ablation is best for domain knowledge but forfeits numerical-reasoning gains, so per-phase contributions are not decomposable and the best checkpoint is task-dependent, with implications for checkpoint retention and scheduling rather than added stages.

items.title: CollabSciReM: Aligning Language Models for Scientific Conversations via Science-Aware Reward Decomposition
items.title_zh: CollabSciReM：通过科学感知奖励分解使语言模型对齐科学对话
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作研究合作者，在多轮交互中进行假设细化、方法规划和技术分析。在此设置中，有用的助手必须准确、方法上有依据、逻辑一致且令牌高效。当前的对齐方法很少能同时实现所有这些。指令调优模型通过冗长获得对话质量，而我们表明，与科学无关的通用协作奖励以牺牲科学严谨性为代价压缩响应。我们提出CollabSciReM，一个目标条件奖励框架，将会话级奖励分解为对话质量、科学严谨性和结构效率。我们还引入SciQuality，一种基于300篇留出科学论文的多轮研究对话成对评估，按六个维度评分：方法合理性、论证、逻辑一致性、事实正确性、新颖性和响应性。在8.62K合成研究对话上微调后，CollabSciReM在SciQuality上优于在相同数据上训练的与科学无关的奖励基线，适用于所有四个Llama和Qwen模型，包括在匹配响应长度下65.3%的胜率。对于7B和8B模型，Colla

extra.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as research collaborators for hypothesis refinement, methodological planning, and technical analysis across multi-turn interactions. In this setting, a useful assistant must be accurate, methodologically justified, logically consistent, and token-efficient. Current alignment approaches rarely achieve all of these together. Instruction-tuned models gain conversational quality through verbosity, and we show that science-agnostic general collaborative rewards compress responses at the expense of scientific rigor. We propose CollabSciReM, a goal-conditioned reward framework that decomposes the session-level reward into conversational quality, scientific rigor, and structural efficiency. We also introduce SciQuality, a pairwise evaluation of multi-turn research conversations grounded in 300 held-out scientific papers and scored on six dimensions: methodological soundness, justification, logical consistency, factual correctness, novelty, and responsiveness. Fine-tuned on 8.62K synthetic research conversations, CollabSciReM is preferred on SciQuality over a science-agnostic reward baseline trained on the same data for all four Llama and Qwen models, including a 65.3% win rate at matched response length. For the 7B and 8B models, CollabSciReM outperforms the science-agnostic reward baseline on the primary metric in 8 of 10 single- and multi-turn benchmark settings. In a blind study, domain experts rated CollabSciReM significantly higher on novelty than the general-reward variant and reported fewer hallucinated responses than both the general-reward variant and the base model.

items.title: The Shape of the DPO Hyperparameter Landscape: What to Measure, How It Moves with Scale, and When Not to Transfer It
items.title_zh: DPO超参数景观的形状：测量什么、如何随规模变化，以及何时不应迁移
items.summary_zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）广泛用于语言模型后训练，但其性能强烈依赖于超参数的选择，例如学习率和参考策略正则化参数$β$。为了更好地理解DPO超参数景观，我们使用密集超参数网格在同一系列的不同模型规模上进行广泛实验。这使我们能够分析最优DPO超参数如何随模型大小和更新步数演变，中间检查点提供廉价信号以加速超参数优化过程。此外，通过在静态和动态基准上评估我们的模型，我们确定哪些基准为超参数选择提供最强信号。最后，我们研究不同最先进超参数优化策略在此设置中的表现。我们的实验表明，最优学习率随模型大小变化，且超参数不可跨训练数据集迁移。我们还发现验证损失是超参数优化的差代理，因为最小化验证损失的超参数仅与下游基准的最优超参数弱相关。因此，DPO超参数需要针对目标模型、数据集和评估目标专门调优。我们还表明，短候选训练运行可大幅降低此选择成本。我们发布所有训练配置和评估结果，以支持对选择质量和训练成本的可

extra.description: Direct preference optimisation (DPO) is widely used for language model post-training, but its performance depends strongly on the choice of its hyperparameters, such as the learning rate and the reference-policy regularisation parameter $β$. To better understand the DPO hyperparameter landscape, we conduct extensive experiments using a dense hyperparameter grid across different model scales from the same family. This allows us to analyse how the optimal DPO hyperparameters evolve with model size and the number of update steps, with intermediate checkpoints providing an inexpensive signal to accelerate the hyperparameter optimisation process. Furthermore, by evaluating our models on both static and dynamic benchmarks, we identify which benchmarks provide the strongest signal for hyperparameter selection. Finally, we investigate how different state-of-the-art hyperparameter optimisation strategies perform in this setting. Our experiments show that the optimal learning rate varies with model size and that hyperparameters are not transferable across training datasets. We also find that validation loss is a poor proxy for hyperparameter optimisation, as hyperparameters that minimize validation loss only weakly correlate with optimal hyperparameters for downstream benchmarks. Therefore, DPO hyperparameters need to be tuned specifically for the target model, dataset, and evaluation objective. We also show that short candidate training runs can substantially reduce the cost of this selection. We release all our training configurations and evaluation results to support reproducible analysis of selection quality and training cost.

items.title: Tensorizing Pairwise Structural Analysis: GPU-Accelerated RMSD and FCC Clustering in HADDOCK3 Without Structural Regression.
items.title_zh: 张量化成对结构分析：HADDOCK3中GPU加速的RMSD和FCC聚类且无结构回归。
items.summary_zh: 整合性大分子对接流程生成数千个候选结构诱饵，依赖下游成对集成分析，包括均方根偏差（RMSD）矩阵和共同接触分数（FCC）聚类，以识别生物学相关的结合姿态。然而，成对结构比较按二次方（O(N^2)）扩展，HADDOCK3中的规范工作流历史上依赖磁盘绑定的轨迹序列化和迭代CPU集合操作，为大型集成造成二次计算和存储瓶颈。在此，我们证明这些操作可重新表述为GPU驻留张量上的连续线性代数：通过批量奇异值分解（SVD）进行结构叠加，通过二进制矩阵乘法（M = A A^T）进行残基接触重叠。在跨越N = 200至10,000个模型（评估多达49,995,000个诱饵对）的经验基准中，我们的GPU实现在Apple Silicon（MPS）上实现6.41倍计算加速，在N = 5,000的NVIDIA CUDA消融中通过消除轨迹磁盘I/O实现高达12.2倍的端到端加速。关键的是，该实现相对于规范基线实现零下

extra.description: Integrative macromolecular docking pipelines generate thousands of candidate structural decoys, relying on downstream pairwise ensemble analysis, including Root-Mean-Square Deviation (RMSD) matrices and Fraction of Common Contacts (FCC) clustering, to identify biologically relevant binding poses. However, pairwise structural comparisons scale quadratically (O(N^2)), and canonical workflows in HADDOCK3 historically rely on disk-bound trajectory serialization and iterative CPU set operations, creating a quadratic computational and storage bottleneck for large ensembles. Here, we demonstrate that these operations can be reformulated as continuous linear algebra on GPU-resident tensors: structural superposition via batched Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and residue contact overlap via binary matrix multiplication (M = A A^T). Across empirical benchmarks spanning N = 200 to 10,000 models (evaluating up to 49,995,000 decoy pairs), our GPU implementation achieves a 6.41-fold compute speedup on Apple Silicon (MPS) and up to 12.2-fold end-to-end acceleration in an N = 5,000 ablation on NVIDIA CUDA by eliminating trajectory disk I/O. Crucially, the implementation achieves zero downstream structural regression relative to canonical baselines, preserving identical cluster assignments (Adjusted Rand Index ARI = 1.0000, zero differing assignments) with sub-microangstrom RMSD concordance (Delta_max <= 4.07 x 10^-7 Angstrom on single-precision MPS; machine-precision Delta_max <= 8.88 x 10^-16 Angstrom on double-precision CUDA). The accelerated code, test suites, and benchmarking workflows are openly accessible on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 license.
